## Checklist

- [ ] ES / EN / FR kept in lock-step (`.md` + `.en.md` + `.fr.md`, or the `es:` / `en:` / `fr:` columns)
- [ ] `bundle exec jekyll build` passes locally (or the **Build site** check is green)
- [ ] New external links verified to open the intended page
- [ ] English text, code, comments and names use American English (see AGENTS.md)
- [ ] No e-mail addresses and no new links into `cnet.fi.uba.ar`
- [ ] New publications carry `topics = {…}` from `_data/publication_topics.yml`
- [ ] Screenshots attached for visual changes
